answer: Require every identity's standing to rest on three disjoint counterparty clusters, like separate valleys feeding one river: work vouched for only inside a single canyon of familiar contacts earns nothing. A glacier moves slowly, and so should trust — each cluster must accumulate independently over time, with no shared counterparties bridging them. An opal's value is its play of distinct colours; likewise, a lone operator running many names cannot fabricate three genuinely separate histories without its contacts, timing, and language betraying the single hand behind them.
